_note: Each rule quotes a published advisory. text_ar empty unless an official Arabic wording is on file. approved_by_lead must be true to ship.

rules.text_en: Authorities "never request personal or banking details through phone calls, text messages, or unknown links".
Dubai Police: do "not rely solely on voice or image verification"; verify through trusted channels.
TDRA, if a WhatsApp account is hacked: contacts should "not to respond to any messages coming from your number". Call instead.
Cyber Security Council: verify content attributed to national institutions through official sources; the public is urged "to refrain from reposting material of doubtful authenticity".
rules.publisher: UAE Cyber Security Council (via The National)
